# Apache HTTPD (HTTPS) — root-context-sse

App at /, Apache terminates TLS on https://localhost:9443/ and forwards over plain HTTP, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. SERVER_FORWARD_HEADERS_STRATEGY=NATIVE so Vaadin builds the push URL with the https scheme and the browser does not block the event stream as mixed content.

Proxy URL on `https://localhost:9443`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# TLS terminated at the proxy, plain HTTP to the backend, SSE only.
#
# X-Forwarded-Proto still matters without WebSocket: Vaadin builds the push URL
# from the advertised scheme, and an https page may not open an http:// event
# stream — the browser blocks it as mixed content.
Listen 443

<VirtualHost *:443>
    ServerName localhost

    SSLEngine on
    SSLCertificateFile      /usr/local/apache2/conf/server.crt
    SSLCertificateKeyFile   /usr/local/apache2/conf/server.key

    RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "https"
    RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Port  "9443"

    <Location />
        ProxyPass         http://vaadin:8080/
        ProxyPassReverse  http://vaadin:8080/
    </Location>
</VirtualHost>
```
